title: Device fan-out to in-app checkout
summary: One phone on black, then three back-view colour variants slide out beside it under a name pill; a price and pay button appear, a cursor clicks, and the film dives into a store app: add to bag, bag page, face-scan confirm.
use_when: Hardware or accessory launch that ends in a buy action
Showing colour or finish variants side by side before a purchase flow
Store or checkout app demo that wants a product-shot opener
Silent autoplay ad on a dark feed

look.type_style: geometric grotesk, semibold, sentence case, small (name pill ~3 % H, price block 3 lines ~3.5 % H); in-app UI at system sizes

sfx.event: each variant phone slides out of the stack
price block and pay button appear
camera dives into the store grid
face-scan ring resolves to a check

structure.shot: one phone, front three-quarter view with a glowing abstract wallpaper, left third of a black frame; a dark name pill top centre
structure.camera: push-in ~4.4 %/s with slight drift right (motion.json, camera-mixed)
structure.motion: phone already on screen at 0.00; name pill words blur-in left to right 0.27-0.77 (~15 fr, easings.outQuint, ±0.25 s); phone glass brightens 0.50

structure.shot: three back-view variants (dark, natural, light) slide out from behind the first phone to the right, forming a fan of four
structure.camera: push-in ~3.5 %/s, pan right ~67 px/s at 1920 in 2.0-3.0 to keep the fan centred-left
structure.motion: variants enter at ~1.00, ~1.75, ~2.25 s, each slides right ~0.25 phone widths and fades from a ghosted translucent state to solid over ~15 fr (springs.heavy, overshoot not measurable); fan settled by 3.27

structure.shot: price block (3 short lines: from-price, monthly price, term) and an outlined pay button appear right of the fan; cursor enters from below
structure.motion: price block fades in 3.27-3.50 (~7 fr, ±0.25 s); button outline glows from 3.50 to 3.77; cursor enters bottom at 4.00 and glides to the button by 4.77 (cursor-path, easings.inOutSine ~23 fr)

structure.shot: click: the fan ghosts out and the frame goes dark, then an empty rounded phone outline grows in the centre and its screen fills with a store grid
structure.motion: click at ~4.77; phones turn translucent 4.77 and fade to black with the text by 5.27 (blur-dissolve ~15 fr, ±0.25 s); blank screen rect appears 5.27 and grows taller to full phone 5.50 (springs.layout); store UI fades in 5.77

structure.shot: in-app product grid on the phone: two cases, two straps, bottom tab bar with bag badge; camera dives to the lower row
structure.camera: zoom tier full to element: ~1.0 to ~3.0 scale between 6.00 and 6.27, then tilt down to the top row by 6.77 (largest motion, diff 3.3)
structure.motion: zoom-tier on springs.cameraIn ~10 fr (±0.25 s, overshoot not measurable); vertical drift 6.27-6.77 ~64 px/s

structure.shot: close crop on the grid top: header with back arrow and continue button, an added-to-bag toast over the first product card
structure.motion: toast lands by 6.77 (from the 6.50 cell, ±0.25 s); hold 1.25 s; continue button brightens at 8.00 (pressed state)

structure.shot: bag page: large page title, then the camera pulls back to the whole phone while the bag list loads (item row, carrier, protection plan, billed-separately card)
structure.camera: pull-out from title detail (~2.5x) to full phone between 8.27 and 8.50 (springs.cameraOut, ±0.25 s)
structure.motion: empty page with a small loader 8.50-8.77; list rows fade in 8.77-9.00 (~7 fr); list scrolls up slowly 9.00-9.77 (easings.linear)

structure.shot: page scrolls to the bottom: help card, subtotal with price, two buttons (primary checkout, white pay button)
structure.motion: in-screen scroll 9.77-10.00 (~7 fr, easings.outQuint, ±0.25 s), settle and hold to 11.00

structure.shot: primary button dims, a face-scan ring appears at the top of the screen, spins, and resolves to a check mark
structure.motion: checkout button greys out at 11.00; scan ring appears 11.27, rotates 11.27-12.00 (thinking-state, easings.linear), turns into a check 12.27 and holds to end

params.variants: 4 device renders (1 front, 3 back-view colourways), transparent PNG or 3D model
params.priceLines: 3 short lines: from-price, monthly price, term
params.storeGrid: 4 product cards (image, label, optional New badge) for the in-app grid
params.bagItems: bag rows: item with price, 2-3 info cards, subtotal

notes: One shot, 0 cuts in cuts.json (near misses at 4.70 and 8.10 are the dissolve and the bag page swap inside the shot), so every transition_out is continuous. Silent reference: every sfx is planned by the glue rule, not measured. All entrance durations are from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s); springs chosen by the no-overshoot rule, overshoot not measurable. Variant entries at 1.00/1.75/2.25 s read from sheet-01 cells. Camera zoom %/s from motion.json. Proposed terms (not used as ids): variant-fan, in-screen-scroll, face-scan-confirm.
